Name: ReverseDivorceBreakup
Author: Avren9
Description:
By monitoring your friendship level with NPCs, this mod allows NPCs to autonomously break up or divorce you.


When your friendship with a dating NPC drops below 4 hearts, they will break up with you the next morning, and you will see a notification.

When your friendship with a spouse is less than 8 hearts but at least 6 hearts, you will receive a warning the next morning. If your friendship returns to this range after increasing, you will receive the warning again.

When your friendship with a spouse drops below 6 hearts, your spouse will divorce you the next morning, and you will see a notification. The spouse’s patio will be  removed immediately, but some NPC spouse room lighting changes may be delayed and will update the next day.

This mod does not support multiple spouse mods.

Manifest.Description: Allows NPCs to initiate breakups or divorces automatically, triggering events based on relationship points.
